description: Creates an isolated browser Fleet or restores the explicitly requested Fleet partition when available.

fleetId.description: Optional Fleet ID. If provided, reuses existing cache/partition or initializes one with this ID.

scope.description: Optional memory scope label for the fleet; defaults to fleetId.

tags.description: Optional tags; when provided they replace prepared Fleet tags.

state.description: Fleet lifecycle state observed after creation.

restored.description: Whether an existing authorized Fleet partition was restored.

partition.description: Browser partition identifier used by the Fleet.

profileId.description: Fingerprint profile ID associated with the Fleet, when configured.

observation.description: Factual observation of the completed Action and its current visible result.

suggested_prompt.description: Action-specific next-step guidance based on the returned result.

state.description: Fleet lifecycle state observed after creation.

restored.description: Whether an existing authorized Fleet partition was restored.

partition.description: Browser partition identifier used by the Fleet.

profileId.description: Fingerprint profile ID associated with the Fleet, when configured.

data.description: Validated business result returned by the Action.

message.description: Concise public explanation for the failure code.

observation.description: Factual observation that does not expose private runtime diagnostics.

suggested_prompt.description: Guidance to re-observe current state and choose the next operation.

details.description: Action-specific public details; private execution diagnostics are omitted.
